name: monti-embed-sdk-monorepo
description: Monti Call Center embed SDK monorepo for vanilla JavaScript, Web Components, React, Vue, and Svelte

scripts.build: npm run build -w @libratech/embed-core && npm run build -w @libratech/embed-vanilla && npm run build -w @libratech/embed-web-component && npm run build -w @libratech/embed-react && npm run build -w @libratech/embed-vue && npm run build -w @libratech/embed-svelte
scripts.test: npm run test -w @libratech/embed-core && npm run check -w @libratech/embed-svelte
